integrity: All mathematical proofs are stated in full in RESULT.md. The two computational programs and reproduced outputs are secondary finite checks; their outputs were replayed. Originality is assessed against the actually inspected scientific material, with identified residual risks. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to finite simple base graphs with equal endpoint-degree parity on every edge. It classifies recurrent states and counts orbits by exact factor coefficients; it does not give arbitrary transient lengths, attraction basins, or efficient factor evaluation. The earliest general threshold-function primary article was not available in full text, leaving some historical-coverage uncertainty.
